name: Legal-Rikai-Open-Benchmark
description:
Dataset Summary
	

Legal Rikai: Open Benchmark is a dataset designed to evaluate LLMs on complex Japanese corporate legal tasks. Unlike existing benchmarks that focus on short-answer QA or classification, this benchmark targets long-form, structured outputs and document-level editing capabilities essential for practical legal work.

evaluation_method: human_eval (supplemented by automated metrics such as ROUGE/BLEU and task-specific success checks)
reputation: A domain-specific Japanese legal benchmark focused on long-form and document-level editing tasks; emerging within the legal-tech and LLM-evaluation community but not yet widely adopted.
